mentions.name: Persona-1
mentions.description: Realtime talking-head avatar AI model that runs at ~2x realtime on an RTX 4090 and significantly faster on enterprise-grade GPUs. Designed primarily for language learning as a conversational partner, pairing a generated face with the voice to build speaking confidence; the surrounding system adds canvas tool use for speaking prompts and images, plus memory to keep conversations less stale.
mentions.problem: Speaking a new language with confidence is hard; adding a face to the voice helps trigger the fight-or-flight response, which is the hardest part of speaking a new language.
mentions.audience: Language learners using an AI conversational partner to practice speaking; with potential for other use cases beyond language learning
mentions.source_excerpt: We've been tinkering with building realtime talking head models (avatar models, etc.) for a while now, and finally have something that works (well enough)! Operates at ~2x realtime on a 4090, significantly faster than that on enterprise grade GPUs.

evidence.value: We've been tinkering with building realtime talking head models (avatar models, etc.) for a while now, and finally have something that works (well enough)! Operates at ~2x realtime on a 4090, significantly faster than that on enterprise grade GPUs.
